reviewFocus.NEW_DEVICE: Confirm whether the active device belongs to the customer and whether it has successful prior usage.
reviewFocus.HIGH_AMOUNT: Compare the held amount with the customer's completed card-payment baseline and recent large purchases.
reviewFocus.UNUSUAL_COUNTRY: Check whether the device location matches the customer's known locations before relying on it.
reviewFocus.REWARD_ABUSE_PATTERN: Review same-amount payments to this merchant and separate duplicate checkout attempts from coordinated abuse.
reviewFocus.HIGH_VELOCITY: Inspect transactions immediately before and after this payment to understand the burst pattern.
reviewFocus.UNUSUAL_TIME: Check whether this UTC transaction time is unusual for this customer, not just unusual in general.
reviewFocus.REPEATED_TRANSFER_PATTERN: Review the repeated transfers to this account and confirm the customer knows the recipient and intended to send each one.

credit.personalLoanDescription: Unsecured instalment loan for general personal expenses.
credit.personalLoanRateNote: Demo fixed annual borrowing rate; final offer depends on score, term, amount and currency.
credit.obligationRepay: Repay monthly instalments on the agreed due dates.
credit.obligationReview: Review pre-contractual information before accepting an offer.
credit.liabilityLate: Late or missed payments can generate additional costs.
credit.liabilityCollections: Persistent non-payment can lead to collections or legal recovery.
credit.personalLoanFocus: Flexible unsecured borrowing for general expenses.
credit.personalLoanRisk: Higher pricing than secured credit because no collateral backs the loan.
credit.mortgageFocus: Large, long-term property financing with collateral and heavier documentation.
credit.mortgageRisk: The property can be enforced after serious default, and variable rates can raise instalments.
credit.autoFocus: Vehicle purchase financing, often linked to the car invoice and insurance.
credit.autoRisk: If secured, the vehicle can be repossessed and the borrower may still owe a shortfall.
credit.studentFocus: Education funding with study-related documents and possible guarantor checks.
credit.studentRisk: Deferred or grace-period interest can still accrue before full repayment starts.
credit.homeImprovementFocus: Renovation or repair funding, usually tied to estimates, invoices or project scope.
credit.homeImprovementRisk: Project overruns do not reduce repayment responsibility.
credit.debtConsolidationFocus: Combines multiple debts into one repayment schedule.
credit.debtConsolidationRisk: A lower monthly payment can still cost more overall if the term is extended.
